desc: Read input values $N, X$, arrays $A, B, P, Q$.
Initialize boolean flags `has_red` and `has_blue` for each box based on initial $A$ and $B$.
Perform a BFS starting from all boxes that initially have balls ($A_i + B_i > 0$).
In the BFS, for a popped box $u$:
If `has_red[u]` is true and $P_u \neq X$, mark $P_u$ as active, set `has_red[P_u] = true`, and add $P_u$ to the queue if not already visited.
If `has_blue[u]` is true and $Q_u \neq X$, mark $Q_u$ as active, set `has_blue[Q_u] = true`, and add $Q_u$ to the queue if not already visited.
Construct a directed graph using only the active boxes (excluding $X$).
Perform a cycle detection (e.g., using DFS) on this graph.
If a cycle is found, print -1.
